reflections.summary: Both Trick Room setters used Trick Room on turn 1, canceling it and leaving the slow, Fighting-weak team exposed to Medicham-Mega and Archaludon's immediate offensive pressure, resulting in a quick wipe.
reflections.adjustment: In the decider, lead Farigiraf + Arcanine to set Trick Room safely with Armor Tail and Intimidate, keep Hatterene in the back, and replace Kingambit with a Ghost- or Flying-type to patch the team's crippling Fighting weakness.
reflections.notebook: Opponent consistently opens with Mega Medicham + Archaludon, spamming Close Combat and Flash Cannon. Mega Medicham's own defenses drop rapidly. Back line options include Aegislash, Corviknight, Pelipper, and Galarian Stunfisk; the actual two brought in game 2 never appeared. Farigiraf's Armor Tail negates Fake Out, enabling a safer Trick Room set. Future plan: lead Farigiraf + Arcanine, hold Hatterene for mid-game, and bring a Fighting-resistant check (e.g., Ghost or Flying) over Kingambit to mitigate the type disadvantage.
